obligation: Cursor marketplace and .cursor-plugin manifest installs are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the content surface and local plugin discovery.
Cloud agent VMs and the remote cloud environment are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the worktree surface and isolated local worktrees.
The Automations Slack bus and direct message integrations are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the benny surface and its webhook receiver.
Grok Bot routines and built-in secret-request cards are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the benny surface.
First-party MCP clients and MCP capability inheritance to children are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the spawn surface.
Cursor sticky host semantics such as frontmatter mode, icon, color, and reminder are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the sticky surface.
Native /loop execution chrome and cadence management are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the loop surface.
Durable background jobs that survive process restarts are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the jobs surface.
Full Electron and IDE driving via control-ui is out of scope; the reproducible twin is the control surface.
The .mdc always-applied rules engine is out of scope; the reproducible twin is the models surface.
The cross-session Cursor transcript store and its lookup primitives are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the sessions surface.
Parent conversation-history inheritance to child agents is out of scope; the reproducible twin is the spawn surface.
